name: p2tr-signature-fraud-spend-type-closure-v0
deployTimeGate: Per the 2026-08-14 multi-agent review, the canonical mirror (PR #971) must leave `setP2TRFraudRouter` unset (i.e. `address(0)`) at deployment time so the manifest's `draft-no-go` status is enforced on-chain. Until each `spendType` is upgraded to `productionApproved: true`, the absence of the router guarantees that no P2TR fraud challenge submission can succeed — the discrepancy between the manifest and any production-activation narrative cannot be misread as sign-off. Re-running the `setP2TRFraudRouter(router)` activation step must be gated on every spend-type in `spendTypes` reaching `productionApproved: true` (or a governance commit to override the manifest), recorded in the deployment record.

openGaps: Fallback classification must remain unapproved for submission.
Add deposit-sweep-specific key-path vectors for one and many deposit inputs.
Correlate accepted deposit sweep proof events to the exact challenge identity.
Add wrong deposit input and wrong output-set negative vectors.

flowSpecificClosure.sharedGateLimit: The shared spentMainUTXOs[utxoKey] gate proves only that the signed input was later accepted as spent by Bridge state. It does not prove moving-funds target-wallet ordering, timeout/below-dust handling, or proof-event correlation for the challenged identity.

openGaps: Complete production moving-funds proof-event correlation from accepted Bridge events to the exact challenge identity and target wallet ordering.
Add timeout or expired moving-funds proof-state negative vectors.
Correlate processed moved-funds sweep proof events to the challenge identity.
Keep pending and timed-out moved-funds sweep requests non-defeating.

flowSpecificClosure.sharedGateLimit: The shared spentMainUTXOs[utxoKey] gate proves only that the signed input was later accepted as spent by Bridge state. It does not prove redeemer output scripts, optional change, fee boundaries, timeout handling, or proof-event correlation for the challenged identity.

openGaps: Complete production redemption proof-event correlation from accepted Bridge events to the exact challenge identity and redeemer output scripts.
Add timed-out redemption request negative vectors.
Decide whether wallet closing is unsupported or tied to the spend type that empties or moves the wallet.
Do not approve standalone wallet-closing signature evidence before that decision is reviewed.
Either add a BIP-340 heartbeat message domain with replay protection or remove heartbeat-style defeat from the P2TR model.
Do not approve heartbeat signature evidence before that decision is reviewed.
